summary: Two independent R3 reviews agree that v26 closes the prior post-cutoff clock classification, event/run separation, input/output ordering, V2 Gate lineage, screening prerequisites, CCC dtype and test-stage ownership, but its composite drops required normative protocols, its protected PIT payload still contains values unavailable before cutoff, nullable status remains ambiguous, the execution lease does not fence the actual worker or predecessors, active-run cannot rotate, replay attempts have no durable retry state, M7 qualification predicates and CCC formula are incomplete, and staging cleanup cannot execute under the specified modes.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
